question: Muje government college me admission lene ke liye kitna rank ana chaye
answer: Dear Student, Admission to a government college does not depend on a single fixed rank. It varies based on the entrance exam, course, college, and your category (General, OBC, SC, ST, etc.). Here is a general estimate for major entrance exams: NEET (MBBS): For General category candidates, admission to a government medical college typically requires around 655+ marks or an All India Rank within approximately 20,000. For reserved categories (OBC, SC, ST), the required rank may be somewhat higher depending on the category and state. JEE Main (B.Tech): For popular branches such as CSE in NITs and IIITs, a rank below 50,000 is generally preferred. For less competitive branches, admissions may be possible at ranks between 1 lakh and 2 lakh, depending on the institute and category. CUET (BA, BSc, BCom, etc.): Admission to top central universities such as Delhi University and Banaras Hindu University generally requires a percentile in the range of 95–100. Cutoffs change every year based on factors such as the number of applicants, seat availability, category, and the popularity of the college and course. You can check, find and access more information here: https://medicine.careers360.com/hi/articles/neet-cut-off-for-government-colleges Hope it helps!

question: How is the gec patan hostel and mess facility
answer: Dear Student, The hostel facilities at Government Engineering College Patan are generally considered decent and affordable for a government engineering college. Separate hostels are available for boys and girls. Rooms are typically allotted on a triple-sharing basis. Basic furniture such as a bed, study table, chair, and cupboard is provided. Facilities include RO drinking water, solar water heating, common rooms, gym facilities, and campus security. The hostels are located close to the academic buildings, making daily commuting convenient. Regarding the mess: An in-house mess facility is available for hostel residents. Student reviews describe the food quality as average to satisfactory. Some students find the food hygienic and suitable for daily use, while others feel the taste and quality can be inconsistent. This variation is common in many government college hostels and often depends on the contractor and management during a particular year. One of the biggest advantages of GEC Patan hostel accommodation is its affordability compared to private colleges and hostels.
